title: External systems
purpose: See the laboratory's other systems that tickets and client organizations link to, and open one to rename it or change its address.
summary: The laboratory's other systems, such as its LIS, LIMS or billing system, that tickets and organizations link to. Only the admin role can open this page.

tasks.title: Add a system
steps: Select [[New external system]], enter its name and kind, and save.

tasks.title: Find a system
steps: Type part of its name, key or address in [[Search]] and select [[Apply]].
Select the system's name to open its edit form.

tasks.title: Rename the starter system
steps: Open Laboratory information system, change its name and address, give the reason and save.

good_to_know: A system is set up once. Staff then choose it when they add a link to a ticket or an organization.
An inactive system takes no new links. Its existing links stay.
The system's key is a stable code shown beside the name. It cannot be changed.
The application never opens or reads a system's address itself. It only stores links that staff can follow.

items.label: Search
items.description: Matches the system name, its key or its base address, ignoring case.

items.label: Status
items.description: All statuses and All show active and inactive systems. Active or Inactive filters on the Active setting.

items.label: New external system
items.description: Opens the form to add a system.

items.label: System
items.description: The system's name, which opens its edit form, with its key beside it. Always shown; default sort is name.

items.label: Kind
items.description: The kind of system chosen on the form. Sortable.

items.label: Base address
items.description: The https address the system's links must be on, or a dash. Sortable; hidden first on narrow screens.

items.label: Filter and sort (phones)
items.description: On a phone the search, status filter, Apply, Clear all and Columns are behind one Filter and sort button.

items.label: Apply / Clear all
items.description: Apply combines the search and the status filter and returns to page 1. Clear all restores the unfiltered list.

items.label: Columns
items.description: Show, hide or reorder columns for your account. The System column stays visible.

items.label: Empty states
items.description: No external systems yet suggests adding the systems your tickets refer to. No systems match these filters offers to clear the filters.

sections.title: Starter system
paragraphs: A new installation has one system named Laboratory information system, of kind LIS, for the laboratory to rename. It is an ordinary system and can be changed or made inactive.
